- to_ascii(s) = "xn--" + ascii_lower(s)
- to_unicode(s) = s with one leading "xn--" prefix removed if present (case-sensitive), else s unchanged

- is_valid_label(s) = !s.is_empty()  (printed as 1/0)
- is_ascii_domain(s) = all bytes < 128 (empty string -> 1)
- is_idn_domain(s) = !is_ascii_domain(s)
- to_lower(s) = ASCII lowercase (only A-Z mapped; multibyte UTF-8 untouched)
- normalize(s) = ascii_lower(s) (identical to to_lower)
- count_labels(s) = number of '.' bytes in s + 1 (empty string -> 1)
Booleans print as "1"/"0". Fields may be empty (then consecutive spaces appear). Output must be byte-for-byte identical to the C++ binary. Args come from std::env::args().
